stories.title: DRDO To Unveil IRSA 2.0 Soon, New Software-Defined Radio For IAF By Year-End
stories.summary: The Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) is set to unveil IRSA 2.0 (Indian Radar System for Air Defence 2.0) in the near future. Additionally, DRDO will provide a new Software-Defined Radio (SDR) to the Indian Air Force (IAF) by the end of the year, enhancing indigenous communication and surveillance capabilities.
stories.why_it_matters_for_ssb: This news highlights India's commitment to indigenous defence technology development and self-reliance (Atmanirbhar Bharat) in critical sectors. It showcases DRDO's role in modernizing the armed forces, particularly the IAF, with advanced communication and air defence systems, which are crucial for national security and strategic autonomy. Aspirants should understand the significance of such developments for India's defence preparedness.
key_facts: DRDO to unveil IRSA 2.0 (Indian Radar System for Air Defence 2.0) soon.
A new Software-Defined Radio (SDR) will be provided to the Indian Air Force (IAF) by year-end.
These are indigenous developments aimed at enhancing India's defence capabilities.
IRSA 2.0 is an advanced radar system for air defence.
SDRs offer flexible and secure communication for modern warfare.
